prose: Bloomberg reports ASI, which builds AI tools for the military and air traffic controllers, has raised a $325 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation led by Spark, after winning an $875 million FAA contract in June. The article could not be fetched, so this summary is limited to the headline.
highlights: ASI raises $325M Series C at a $3B valuation, led by Spark
Builds AI tools for military and air traffic control
Follows an $875M FAA contract in June
